description: Na₂Mn(SiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.71 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.61 Å) and four longer (2.67 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.22 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.43 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three MnO₆ octahedra, corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-45°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid, corners with three MnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-52°. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Mn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Mn, and one Si atom.
